profile.headline: Senior Game Developer | Building AI Agents for Immersive Experiences
profile.summary:
Everything you build should surprise and delight!

I'm a full-stack engineer who builds innovative, novel products in cutting edge fields. Give me a mission and a team, and I will build you a product that matches your vision and wows your users.

I have a laser-focus on what your product needs to be successful, and from my position as a senior engineer, I will remove roadblocks and discover solutions that lead to our product's success. In my career, I've launched successful products in the VR, gaming, and AI spaces, including the mobile AR virtual pet Peridot, as well as Strivr's VR training headset experience.

I have a decade of experience with VR, 3D mathematics, and team management. As well as a deep experience with critical languages like C#, C++, and Python, I'm also constantly learning and keeping up to date with the right tools for any job.

If you have a need for a product-focused engineer who will work with you to deliver something new and impactful, don't hesitate to connect.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
•	Built novel XR+AI Prototypes in a custom C++ game engine with Python scripting to enable complex voice-command-driven interactions within an immersive 6DoF experience.
•	Designed an Alexa-like AI Assistant using structured outputs from OpenAI, integrating FasterWhisper for real-time transcription and Google Voice for output.
•	Created a Secure Command-Chain System where AI selected safe, validated in-app actions, delivered via JSON data serialization between the assistant and game engine.
•	Developed a Smart Translator for seamless multilingual communication during VR phone calls.
•	Prototyped a virtual clay sculpting demo utilizing a time-of-flight (ToF) sensor, which processes over 400,000 depth points with concurrent, vectorized voxel collision for real-time hand-based sculpting. Performance profiling led to a frame rate optimization with 90fps even with the maximum number of collisions happening simultaneously.
•	Contributed to funding milestones by rapidly delivering high-impact prototypes.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · C# · Virtual Reality (VR) · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Game Development · Python (Programming Language) · C++

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Built features for the game Peridot on top of Niantic’s Lightship semantic segmentation library
•	Gave talks about our Convolutional Neural Net and how we use it at AWE and GDC 
•	Built & maintained various data manipulation tools to aid design & development – breeding system tool, build-a-dot tool, & game constants editor
•	Full-stack planning, development, and shipping of features spanning UI, server, & data design
•	Headed feature dev for systems such as breeding, genetics, matchmaking, spectacles, foraging
•	Server engineering in Java, utilizing Redis and Spanner
•	Building reliable, future-proofed user data formats using Protocol Buffers 
•	Backwards compatibility development for V2s of these systems
•	Client engineering in Unity3D C#
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spanner · C# · Unity3D · Protocol Buffers · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Redis

positions.title: VR Engineer
positions.description:
- Led design of STRIVR Player, a VR headset training client written in Unity3D C# for Oculus, Go, Daydream, Gear, Pico.
 - Created STRIVR Creator, a desktop tool for designers to build training content.
 - Architected JSON data format read by STRIVR Player and written by STRIVR Creator.
 - Published a chapter in “Creating Augmented & Virtual Realities” under O’Reilly Media.

positions.title: AR Engineer
positions.description:
- Built and led the team to create an award-winning AR data visualization platform called Immersive Insights, written in Unity3D C# for HoloLens.  This allowed scientists to use existing tools like R Studio to visualize their data in real-time, in 3D.
 - Server architecture allowed usage of any data source for geo-scatterplot visualization.
 - Multi-user architecture allowed many clients to view and interact with the same data.

positions.title: Android Engineer
positions.description: Member of the team that developed Hilton Hotel’s HHonors Straight to Room application.  This app uses your phone as your hotel door key and provides easy travel planning tools to book and modify your hotel stay, to manage and redeem points, etc.

positions.title: Gameplay Engineer
positions.description: Member of the team that designed and developed Road Redemption, a Unity3D motorbike fighting/racing game for PC, Mac, Switch.

positions.title: Game Producer and Programmer
positions.description: Teaching students to FINISH games instead of just start them.

projects.title: Queen At Arms
projects.description: Queen At Arms is a dating sim developed by Rosstin, Serenity, Meagan, Lilin, and Emily. It stars a young girl who becomes the commander of a medieval army.

projects.title: Rex Rocket
projects.description: Join us in a retro sci-fi adventure! Battle your way through slime and angry robots in a desperate attempt to save ship and crew!
